text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: How is your life at the Academy, Rose?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There are largely no issues.
Having more opportunities to experience
the culture of the common folk...
each day is rich with learning.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see... That is a wonderful thing.
Was there any culture that piqued your
interest?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... This thing called "social media"
is brought up quite often.
Seeing everyone engage with it so fervently
has piqued my interest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—Still,
I remain rather unfamiliar with it.
Perhaps I should ask my classmates to
enlighten me once more...)

text_block_list.name: City & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You wish to learn about social media
trends...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
You two would be quite knowledgeable about
this, wouldn't you?
If you would be so kind,
I would appreciate your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Dunno about trends or whatever~
For now,
ain't it all about the 'gram?
The aesthetic!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Decking your school bag out to the max is
the absolute best!
What's yours looking like right now, Rose?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I hear ya!! Totally plain!!
Let's glam it up, glam it waaaay up!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Attaching a plushie is totally the move!
Like a raccoon dog or something~ Isn't that
chill-cute?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And stuff like this—food keychains!
It's super huge, right? Pretty crazy,
huh? Legit so cute!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Good heavens...
To think accessories could be so large...
'Photogenic appeal' is a profound art
indeed...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Juice cartons are actually totally aesthetic,
y'know?
There're tons of super cute designs.
Like, you can post a pic going,
'chillin' with the besties~' and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see... Indeed, lined up like this,
it makes for a truly splendid sight...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right? Pretty much anything with a bright,
flashy design like this pops in photos,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and short-form videos~
I totally recommend this spot.
You can do literally anything.
Like dancing~ or can dominoes!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like,
check out this pic I snapped the other
day!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ho, quite lively.
Truly fascinating...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The location is wonderful as well.
Vibrant with color,
and profoundly charming.
So this is what they call “photogenic”...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, for now,
why doesn't Rose just try taking one too?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My thanks to you both.
I shall attempt crafting it based on your
insights.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Love it~
Let me know once you film it!
I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...And that is how I came to accept the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom's venture into short-form
videos...
I braced myself,
determined to support her with all my
might.
choice_data_list: What kind of performance will you ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... According to my classmate,
"social media is all about the aesthetic"—
one is apparently meant to "hype things
up."
I imagine the grander and more glamorous it is,
the better.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I consider past entertainments I have
experienced that might serve as a
reference...
perhaps orchestral and piano recitals—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Alternatively, there is opera
or classical ballet, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. If it is a one-woman play,
perhaps it could be recreated?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is the location. Naturally,
I would prefer
something grand and visually striking...
but what are your thoughts?
choice_data_list: Against the backdrop of the vast o...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case,
there is a fine spot at a hotel I
frequent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"My name is Rose Kingdom.
I am the sovereign of the Kingdom of
Roses."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“In accordance with the ancient covenant,
I shall dedicate my blade to this beautiful
kingdom————”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out tremendously glamorous.
Though I'm starting to feel it might be a
bit too lavish for a mere short-form
video...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation.
Tomorrow,
I shall ask our classmates for their
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: City & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way,
this is getting crazy insane?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Then let us promptly search for a sea with
a scenic view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Boom! Splaaasssh!!*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I am the bearer of the House of Roses' title:
the Sword Saint—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"One who cleaves through the fiercest
waves,
and surges ever onward!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out to be an intensely powerful
finished product.
Though I'm starting to feel it might be a
bit too grand
to call a mere short video...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation.
Tomorrow,
I shall ask our classmates for their
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: City & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way,
this is getting crazy insane?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Omg, isn't this crazy gorgeous?! And like,
isn't Lady Rose ridiculously cool?!
Like straight out of a play?!
Like a real prince?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Or rather,
is this backdrop...
maybe the real deal...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Ah,
I went to this location in person
to take some photos, but...
Was there something strange about it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
seriously?
That video I showed you earlier had a
composite app background, though...
Man, you're really something, Rose...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! No, seriously, this is insane!
This is gonna go crazy viral!
Absolutely the best!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Thanks to you all,
I have learned yet another lesson.
I would be delighted if you could continue
to teach me in the future.

text_block_list.name: City & Jordan
text_block_list.text: ――Naturally!!
